issues.note: The ticket overview gives 09:00–18:00 for the main conference. The detailed schedule and final talk pages end at 18:30 on October 15 and 16. Use the detailed session times; this difference is unresolved with the organizer.
The checked public pages give Main Stage and Side Track labels but no physical room mapping. Workshop pages name WeWork without individual rooms. Use event signs or ask the organizer.
The linked registration page hides the address until registration. No restricted address is reproduced.
Group dinners start at 20:00 on October 15; no end time or restaurant assignments are published.

The sitemap includes Dmitriy Kovalenko’s file-search talk. Its page gives no date, time, or stage, and the current schedule has no entry. It is excluded from scheduled choices; no cancellation is inferred.
The unversioned impl-room URL redirects to a 2025 event. It is not evidence for a 2026 room assignment.
